pr_title: expression: Add the check for expression evaluation in some executors

### What problem does this PR solve?

Issue Number: close #16337 

Problem Summary:
Lack of the check when we use expression evaluation in some executors.

### What is changed and how it works?
Add the check to the `EvalExpr` to choose whether it uses the `VecExpr` or `Expr`.

### Related changes
Rename `VecEval` to `EvalExpr`.
Add the check to the `EvalExpr` to choose whether it uses the `VecExpr` or `Expr`.

- Unit test
- Integration test

> can we tell whether the expression is evaluated in the column-oriented way or the row-oriented way?

Yes, but I don’t think it’s necessary. After `TiDB v4.0`, almost every expression has already finished the vectorized expression evaluation. We can determine it by looking at the environment variable `EnableVectorizedExpression`.

issue_context.title: Lack of the check when we use expression evaluation in some executors
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

### Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!
In some [executors](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/expression/expression.go#L327), it will use the [`VecEval`](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/expression/expression.go#L468) when they want to evaluate expressions. But we need to do some checks to chose whether it can use the `VeclEval` or `Eval`.

### What version of TiDB are you using? (`tidb-server -V` or run `select tidb_version();` on TiDB)
latest master [e90aac2](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/commit/e90aac27105ba38b2d4494ce88982eea254bd6b2)

review_comments: How about adding a check `assert(colExpr.Vectorized(), IsTrue)` here?
